description: CV-controlled eight-way crossfader: a window of gain sweeps across eight inputs, each input on its own output plus a summed mix

params.text: Sweeps the window across the inputs, 0 to 5
Sets how many inputs the sweep covers, two at the minimum and eight at the maximum, with eight by default
Widens the window so more inputs are open at once, 0 to 5; at 0 one input is open at a time
Shapes the fade between stages, a curved taper at 0 and a straight ramp at 5
Sends 5V to every input jack left unpatched, so the outputs carry the fade shapes themselves as CV; a cable in All In overrides it
Scales the Mix output, 0 to 1, set to one eighth by default

inputs.text: One of the eight signals being scanned; unpatched it carries the All In jack, or 5V when the offset switch is set to +5V
Adds to the scan position, in volts
Adds to the stage count, a volt per stage
Adds to the width setting, in volts
Adds to the slope setting, in volts
Feeds this signal to every input jack left unpatched

outputs.text: That one input at the gain the scan window currently gives it
All eight scanned outputs summed and scaled by the Mix trimpot
